text: Program Description This course is taught by School of Business Administration Why Choose To Study This Program With its information technology, management, professional knowledge and good English communication skills, It often attend some international conferences and international events, such as bipolar conference, Harvard University, harvard business "model United Nations" conference, Norway international student section (ISFIT), bayer ECO - young MINDS environment BBS, etc., and students have been selected as bayer youth ambassador for the environment. Course Language course: Intensive reading, extensive reading and heard, writing, translation, British and American national culture and literature, English, advanced interpretation, etc. After four years of study, students can master English in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating of language skills, and to study a second foreign language. Students in grade two and grade four, respectively, to participate in the test for English majors 4 and 8, through the recognized certificate of English professional 4, 8. Academic course: computer system structure, data structure, database principle and application, computer network and management information system, information system analysis and design, program design, ERP, marketing, operations management, macroeconomics, management, e-commerce, multinational management, cross-cultural management, organizational behavior, etc. In addition, students can take business management, public relations and professional elective courses. Some specialized courses adopt the internationally used English original edition teaching material, and use English or bilingual teaching. Length of Schooling: 4 years Admission only available in Fall Semester, opening in September The exact opening date is available in Acceptance Letter. Career Students can go to PWC, Deloitte, Ernst & Young, KPMG and other international well-known accounting firm work, and also can go to IBM, Shanghai and other famous IT companies, or Bank of China, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, foreign banks and multinationals such as Unilever, Procter & Gamble. The graduates both specialized in English and information management technology, and in the job market they have obvious competitive advantage; they will be welcomed by choose and employment faculties. Application Deadline For the programs in Hongkou Campus by June 30 Completion of Program Diploma and Certificate of Bachelor\'s Degree will be issued to those who have completed the undergraduate program with qualified academic standing. Notes 1) This major won’t be available unless there is an enrollment of 10 or above. 2) The financial support and custody may be student\'s parents or relatives in Shanghai. 3) Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU.
